# Grammatica · Grammar

**[arogno-grammar.pdf](arogno-grammar.pdf)** has the whole grammar for printing.

A short grammar of the dialect of Rögn (Arogno), written from the course material: the lessons and Guido Casellini's exercise sheets. Every chapter explains in Italian and English side by side; the examples and tables are in dialect, each example with the document and line it comes from. † marks a statement worked out from the forms in the course rather than stated by it, and, in a verb table, a predicted form.

The text was drafted by Claude (Anthropic) and has not yet been checked by the teacher: see [TO-CHECK.md](../TO-CHECK.md). The chapters themselves are kept in [`etc/grammar/`](../etc/grammar/) and the examples in [`etc/grammar_examples.csv`](../etc/grammar_examples.csv).
